notes.title: The Ukraine Games Festival has begun!
notes.notes: [p]The Ukrainian Gaming Festival is here. As participants in this celebration, we invite you to join us! To do so, we are offering you an 80% discount on a game about moonshine, sunflowers with watermelons, and aliens.[/p]

notes.title: Ukraine Games Festival has started
notes.notes:
This day has come! Ukraine Games Festival, one of the main events of the year for Ukrainian gamers, is starting! Of course, we haven't missed it and are taking part as well!

Cosmoodyssey 2 is now on sale with an 80% discount! So, we are waiting for your purchases and your reviews!

The discount will last only a week, that is, it will be valid while the festival is going on!
